note: Collected on 2026-11-06 using about 38 web searches. Direct page fetches were blocked by the session network policy (luluhypermarket.com and carrefouruae.com did not resolve), so every price comes from search-engine snapshots/snippets of the cited pages, not from live pages. The search tool summarises results, so seen_snippet is the closest quote or paraphrase available. Item-to-URL mapping is to the page the snippet came from; some IKEA items were seen across several ikea.com/ae category pages and are attributed to the limited-time-offers page. IKEA's offers hub is titled 'Singles' Week Offers ... Online Only', so IKEA prices may be online-only. The amazon.ae prices are labelled '11.11 Prime Deal' (Prime members). Carrefour product-page prices carry countdown timers and no confirmed year, so their end dates are left null. Lulu, Union Coop, Nesto, Spinneys, Choithrams, Sharaf DG, noon, ACE, Home Centre and Centrepoint/Max: only catalogue titles/dates, coupon codes or undated prices were found, so no item offers were recorded. Every item must be checked against the live page before publishing.
